title: In This Town — Hide and Seek

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: In this town, everybody parties.
beats.visual: Crane down the party street.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Except me. I'm counting.
beats.visual: Empty square at night: the kid with his face against a lamppost, hands over his eyes. Counter 999,941.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: One number per HUSS; the counter ticks up.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: We started hide and seek on a Friday. It's still Friday.
beats.visual: The square banner FRIDAY NIGHT / PARTY / 14.05.1982.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Nobody hid. They threw a party instead.
beats.visual: The party street, packed.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The cat hid in a box. The box went clubbing.
beats.visual: A cardboard box with a cat tail sticking out dances in the crowd in a party hat.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Grandad hid behind a lamppost. He's wider than the lamppost.
beats.visual: Grandad behind a thin lamppost, sticking out both sides.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Grandad shuffles left, right, left behind the pole on each HUSS. Still visible.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The best hiding place is in plain sight. The pigeon. Mayor.

card.quote: The best hiding place is in plain sight.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD; attribution on 'The pigeon'; reveal: the pigeon in its mayor hat on the stage, perfectly visible.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Brenda's still frozen from freeze dance. Best hider in town.
beats.visual: Brenda still frozen mid-dance; a moth on her; tag NOBODY'S CHECKED.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Top ten respectful moments. Number four: the moon closed its eyes too.
beats.visual: TOP 10 card #4; the moon over the square closes its eyes.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Nine hundred ninety nine thousand, nine hundred and ninety nine.
beats.visual: Silence. Slow push in on the kid at the lamppost. Counter 999,999.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: One million. Ready or not.
beats.visual: Counter 1,000,000. On 'Ready' the kid turns around.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: The kid tags one hider per HUSS: box, Grandad, pigeon, Brenda, Marcus, the mayor. FOUND stamp each time.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Found everyone. Four seconds.
beats.visual: Everyone found, standing in a line; tag 4 SECONDS.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Sixteen thousand nights of counting. Four seconds of finding.
beats.visual: Split: the kid at the lamppost across many nights; then the stopwatch 0:04.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Rules are rules. A box.
beats.visual: QUOTE CARD; attribution on 'A box'; the box nods (cat tail wags).

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: So now in this town, everybody counts.
beats.visual: The whole town faces lampposts, walls and trees, eyes covered, counting.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Except me. I'm partying.
beats.visual: The kid alone on the empty dance floor in a party hat; disco lights.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: The kid dances alone; fireworks on each HUSS; behind him the town keeps counting.
